summary: Mobile UI/UX Redesign Plan for SalahMate featuring custom Canvas Islamic geometric patterns, glassmorphic gradients, an animated Home sky-gradient & prayer arc hero card, 2-column Bento grids, Mushaf-style Quran verse frames with a floating audio mini-player, an interactive 3D-feel Tasbih bead ring, and an astrolabe-inspired ornate Qibla compass dial.
